Name: Segment Image Compressed Blocks Directory
Description: This support extension is the directory for compressed image segment blocks. The segment image compressed blocks directory shall follow immediately after the subheader file.

BOFF.Name: Block Offset
BOFF.Description: This field shall contain the offset from the beginning of the image data to the beginning of the data for this block expressed in bytes.

BLEN.Name: Block Length
BLEN.Description: This field shall contain the length of the compressed block expressed in total number of bytes.
